continuity: The swift ship was attacked by government military vessels near the landing; Sama Pyo, Taishan, Song Ilseom, and Ju Hwaran deflected the cannonballs, and the ship continued toward the landing.
Ju Wongong recognized Jin Taekyung and ordered the government vessels to cease fire; Jin says he once saved Ju Wongong’s life.
plot: The military vessels’ cannon fire fails to hit the swift ship, and Sama Pyo, Taishan, Song Ilseom, and Ju Hwaran deflect the next volley as the ship heads for the landing. Jin wonders why the government troops attacked and orders a river pirate to steer under a white flag rather than retaliate.

On a pleasure boat, Ju Wongong dismisses concerns about the Yangtze River Channel League and boasts of the government’s strength. When he sees the swift ship withstand the cannon fire and recognizes Jin through a thousand-li lens, he orders the military vessels to cease fire, invoking his imperial kinship; Jin says he once saved Ju Wongong’s life.
translation_decisions: Render 황족명 as “imperial-family command”; Ju Wongong’s claim is not an established form of imperial authority.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is the World Hunter Federation’s Alliance Leader.
Jin erased the Doppelganger, but Main Quest [Cataclysm] and its “Stop the Summoning” mission failed.
The Rift began at 10%; its progress increases the distribution and concentration of magical power.
Jin was transferred to Murim while unconscious and awakened in Nanman after several days.
The System’s Status Window is inaccessible; Jin suspects an update may be responsible.
Jin saw a vision of a black-haired man killing Ahomed after the ritual; whether it was real remains unknown, and Jin believes the man was not Asmodeus.
Jin’s [Broken Body] injury around his lower dantian remains unresolved; leveling up did not heal it.
Jeok Cheongang went to Sichuan to bring the Divine Physician, his former Disciple, to treat Jin.
Jin’s party traveled by swift ship from Nanman toward Sichuan; government military vessels fired on the ship near the landing, and Ju Wongong ordered them to cease fire after recognizing Jin.
Jin says he once saved Ju Wongong’s life.
open_questions: Why did the Main Quest fail despite the Doppelganger’s erasure, and who or what was summoned?
Was Jin’s vision of the summoned being real, System-delivered, or prophetic?
What will happen as the Rift progresses and more beings enter the world?
Who or what chose Jin, and what is the Ark?
What changed in the System update, and when will its functions return?
temporary_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Keep Blink distinct from Teleport and Warp; extended-range Blink causes severe strain.
Keep Fire Storm and Aqua Storm as distinct named spells.
Render [영웅의 검] as “Hero’s Sword,” 에어 슬래시 as “Air Slash,” and 실드 마법 as “Shield magic.”
Render 선택받은 자 as “the Chosen One,” 방주의 주인 as “the Master of the Ark,” [격변] as [Cataclysm], [어데 도씹니꺼] as “Where’s Your Do Clan From?,” and [종족 학살자] as “Species Slayer.”

names.notes: Optical instrument Ju Wongong received as a gift.
Ju Wongong’s claimed authority to command the troops, distinct from an imperial edict.
